item.title: Bursa Malaysia closes lower on profit-taking
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Profit-taking activities dragged down Bursa Malaysia to close lower on Tuesday after the strong gains recorded yesterday. At 5pm, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) decreased 3.76 points to 1,747.54 from 1,751.30 at yesterday’s close. The market’s benchmark index opened 4.16 points higher at 1,755.46 before moving as low as 1,745.41 in early trade and reaching a high of 1,761.57 at noon. item.title: The face of Isa Samad being sent to Sungai Buloh Prison
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The sullen face of former Felda Chairman Tan Sri Mohd Isa Abdul Samad was captured on camera as a police vehicle took him from the Federal Court here on Tuesday, heading to Sungai Buloh Prison. The 77-year-old former Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar was taken out at 3.25pm ​​in a Honda City police vehicle, escorted by several officers. item.title: Malaysia improves to 54th position in Corruption Perceptions Index 2025
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia’s position in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) has improved, from 57th place in 2024 to 54th place last year, reflecting continued progress in governance and efforts to combat corruption. Based on the 2025 CPI released by Transparency International (TI) today, Malaysia is ranked third among ASEAN countries, after Singapore and Brunei, maintaining its relative position in Southeast Asia while outperforming several regional countries.
